Proof

\sketch Differentiate $V= abla X^*$ in normal coordinates, commute covariant derivatives, and use the contracted Bianchi identity; the intermediate identity is

egin{equation} \partial _tV=(- abla ^l\Ric _{kj}+ abla _k\Ric _j^l+ abla _j\Ric _k^l)X_l^*dx^k\otimes dx^j + abla (\Delta X^*-\Ric (X,\cdot )). \end{equation}
